do
    ash --login

#!/bin/busybox sh

INITRC_DIR=/sbin/initrc
DEFAULT_MODE=3
KMSG=/dev/kmsg
BOOT_TIME=/proc/snsc_boot_time
MODE_FILE=/setting/mode/dmode
SEN_FILE=/setting/sen/smode
FSTAB=$INITRC_DIR/fstab
FSTAB_EXT=$INITRC_DIR/fstab.ext

setup_bis()
{
    UPM_BOOTMODE=`cat /proc/udm/upm_bootmode`
    echo "upm_bootmode = $UPM_BOOTMODE" > $KMSG
    echo "upm_bootmode = $UPM_BOOTMODE" > $BOOT_TIME

    [ "$UPM_BOOTMODE" != "BIS" ] && return 1

    SSBIPROF_MNTSRC=`grep -v '^#' $FSTAB | grep /log | busybox cut -f 1`
    SSBIPROF_MNTTGT=`grep -v '^#' $FSTAB | grep /log | busybox cut -f 2`
    SSBIPROF_MNTOPT=`grep -v '^#' $FSTAB | grep /log | busybox cut -f 4`

    busybox umount $SSBIPROF_MNTTGT
    /sbin/mkdosfs -f 1 -s 32 $SSBIPROF_MNTSRC
    busybox mount $SSBIPROF_MNTSRC $SSBIPROF_MNTTGT -o $SSBIPROF_MNTOPT

    return 0
}

setup_senser()
{
    [ -r $SEN_FILE ] || return 1

#   echo $SEN_FILE found.
    SEN_STR=`cat $SEN_FILE`
    if   [ "$SEN_STR" == "UU" ] ; then
        /usr/bin/sen.elf &
    fi

    return 0
}

busybox mount -t sysfs none /sys
busybox mount -t debugfs none /sys/kernel/debug
busybox mount -a -T $FSTAB

[ -r $FSTAB_EXT ] && busybox mount -a -T $FSTAB_EXT

mount -t tmpfs none /tmp_wbshd

MODE="$DEFAULT_MODE"
[ -r $MODE_FILE ] && MODE=`cat $MODE_FILE`

if [ "$MODE" != "0" ] ; then
    ### set_mindrv()
    echo set > /proc/udm/drivers

    [ -r $INITRC_DIR/setup_shielding ] && . $INITRC_DIR/setup_shielding
    [ -r $INITRC_DIR/insmod_drv2     ] && . $INITRC_DIR/insmod_drv2

    setup_bis || setup_senser

    /usr/bin/bootin.elf &
fi

[ -r $INITRC_DIR/setup_console ] && . $INITRC_DIR/setup_console

while true
do
    ash --login
done

ROOTFS_OLDTGT="/initrd"
FSTAB_ROOT="$INITRC_DIR/fstab.root"

do_pivot_root()
{
	[ -r $FSTAB_ROOT ] || return 1
	busybox mount -a -T $FSTAB_ROOT

	ROOTFS_MNTTGT=`busybox cut -f 2 $FSTAB_ROOT`

	cd $ROOTFS_MNTTGT

	/sbin/pivot_root . $ROOTFS_MNTTGT$ROOTFS_OLDTGT

	busybox mount --move $ROOTFS_OLDTGT/proc /proc
	busybox mount --move $ROOTFS_OLDTGT/dev  /dev

	exec busybox chroot . /bin/ash -c "busybox umount $ROOTFS_OLDTGT; freeramdisk /dev/ram0; /sbin/init2;" < dev/console > dev/console 2>&1
}

busybox mount | grep nfs >> /dev/null
is_nfs=$?
if [ "$is_nfs" != 0 ] ; then
	do_pivot_root
fi

/dev/nflasha2	/setting vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr	0	0
/dev/nflasha3	/system	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr	0	0
/dev/nflasha8	/cp	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr	0	0
/dev/nflasha11	/log	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr,batch_sync	0	0
/dev/nflasha12	/cert	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr,batch_sync	0	0
/dev/nflasha18	/lens	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr	0	0
/dev/nflasha10	/tmp	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,posix_attr	0	0
/dev/nflasha15	/usr	ext2	ro,nodiratime,noatime,sync	0	0

#/dev/nflasha2	/setting vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec	0	0
#/dev/nflasha3	/system	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec	0	0
#/dev/nflasha8	/cp	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec	0	0
#/dev/nflasha11	/log	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec,batch_sync	0	0
#/dev/nflasha12	/cert	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec,batch_sync	0	0
#/dev/nflasha18	/lens	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec	0	0
#/dev/nflasha10	/tmp	vfat	rw,nodiratime,noatime,sync,noexec	0	0
#/dev/nflasha15	/usr	ext2	ro,nodiratime,noatime,sync	0	0

# for job control
TTYCMD="ash --login"

grep "console\=" /proc/cmdline >/dev/null
if [ "$?" -ne "1" ]; then
	CMDLINE=`cat /proc/cmdline`
	for i in ${CMDLINE}
	  do
		case "${i}" in
		  console\=*)
			l_console=`echo "${i}" | busybox cut -f2 -d=`
			# Parse the console line. No options specified if
			# no comma
			CONSOLE=`echo $l_console | busybox cut -f1 -d,`
			if [ "${CONSOLE}" = "" ]; then
			  # no options specified
			  CONSOLE=${l_console}
			fi
				# check console device available at /dev 
				if [ ! -e /dev/${CONSOLE} ]; then
				  case "${CONSOLE}" in
					"ttymxc0")
						if [ ! -e /dev/ttymxc0 ]; then
							busybox mknod /dev/ttymxc0 c 207 16;
						fi
					;;
					"ttyAMA0")
						if [ ! -e /dev/ttyAMA0 ]; then
					  		busybox  mknod /dev/ttyAMA0 c 204 64;
						fi
				  	;;
					"ttyO0")
						if [ ! -e /dev/ttyO0 ]; then
					  		busybox  mknod /dev/ttyO0 c 253 0;
						fi
				  	;;
					*)   # for no device file
						TTYCMD="ash --login"
						break;
				  	;;
					esac
				fi
			CONSOLE_BAUDRATE=`busybox stty speed -F /dev/$CONSOLE`
			TTYCMD="/sbin/getty -n -L -l /bin/ash ${CONSOLE_BAUDRATE} /dev/${CONSOLE} linux"
		;;
		esac
	done
fi

while true
do
  $TTYCMD
done

#!/bin/sh

UPMNT=/setting
UPDIR=$UPMNT/updater
UPMODE=$UPDIR/mode
UPMODE1=$UPDIR/mode1

LSI_MAIN=1
LSI_SUB=2

#######################################
### Function declaration

### change to usermode
func_usermode()
{
	#delete other mode flags
	rm -f $UPDIR/mode*

	#create mode flag
	touch $UPDIR/mode

	#sync
	sync

	# file check and message
	if [ -f "$UPMODE" ] ; then
		echo "next boot...   UFP mode"
	else
		echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
	fi
}

### change to version skip mode
func_verskip()
{
	#delete other mode flags
	rm -f $UPDIR/mode*

	#create mode flag
	touch $UPDIR/mode $UPDIR/mode6

	#sync
	sync

	# file check and message
	if [ -f "$UPDIR/mode6" ] ; then
		echo "next boot...   Version Skip mode"
	else
		echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
	fi
}

### change to version skip mode
func_mscrypt()
{
	#delete other mode flags
	rm -f $UPDIR/mode*

	#create mode flag
	touch $UPDIR/mode $UPDIR/mode5

	#sync
	sync

	# file check and message
	if [ -f "$UPDIR/mode5" ] ; then
		echo "next boot...   MS Crypt mode"
	else
		echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
	fi
}

### change to file crypt mode
func_filecrypt()
{
        #delete other mode flags
        rm -f $UPDIR/mode*

        #create mode flag
        touch $UPDIR/mode $UPDIR/mode7

        #sync
        sync

        # file check and message
        if [ -f "$UPDIR/mode7" ] ; then
                echo "next boot...   File Crypt mode"
        else
                echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
        fi
}

### change to servicemode
func_servicemode()
{
	#delete other mode flags
	rm -f $UPDIR/mode*

	#create mode flag
	touch $UPDIR/mode $UPDIR/mode3

	#sync
	sync

	# file check and message
	if [ -f "$UPDIR/mode3" ] ; then
		echo "next boot...   Service mode"
	else
		echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
	fi

}

### change to keepbackup mode
func_keepbackup()
{
	#delete other mode flags
	rm -f $UPDIR/mode*

	#create mode flag
	touch $UPDIR/mode $UPDIR/mode1 $UPDIR/mode4

	#sync
	sync

	# file check and message
	if [ -f "$UPDIR/mode4" ] ; then
		echo "next boot...   Keepbackup mode"
	else
		echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
	fi
}


### modify version
## $1 : target version
func_modver()
{
	local _newver=$1
	test ${#_newver} -eq 4 || { echo "Invalid Parameter" ; return 1 ; } 

	if [ ! -e /root/IAMUPDATER ] ; then
		mount -t tmpfs -o size=1024 tmpfs /tmp_updater
	fi

	#get current version
	ud_datcnv.elf -d -i /setting/updater/dat4 -o /tmp_updater/upcurver -a
	if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
		echo "Could not get current version" ; return 1 ;
	fi
	local _current
	_current=`cat /tmp_updater/upcurver`

	rm -f /tmp_updater/upcurver

	#write new version into tempfile
	echo "$_newver" > /tmp_updater/upnewver
	ud_datcnv.elf -e -i /tmp_updater/upnewver -o /setting/updater/dat4 -a
	if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
		echo "Could not write new version" ; return 1 ;
	fi

	#sync
	sync
	sync

	rm -f /tmp_updater/upnewver

	if [ ! -e /root/IAMUPDATER ] ; then
		umount /tmp_updater
	fi

	#message
	echo "Modify verion $_current -> $_newver"
}

### modify model
## $1 : target model
func_modmod()
{
	func_com_mod_modreg "model" "dat2" $1
}

### modify region
## $1 : target region
func_modreg()
{
	func_com_mod_modreg "region" "dat3" $1

}

### common func modmod, modreg
# $1 : Prompt String
# $2 : filename ( dat2 or dat3 )
# $3 : new value
func_com_mod_modreg()
{
	local _file=$2
	local _newval=$3
	test ${#_newval} -eq 8 || { echo "Invalid Parameter" ; return 1 ; }

	if [ ! -e /root/IAMUPDATER ] ; then
		mount -t tmpfs -o size=1024 tmpfs /tmp_updater
	fi

	mkdir -p /tmp_updater/upmnt
	mount -t vfat /dev/nflasha1 -o posix_attr,noatime,nodiratime,shortname=mixed /tmp_updater/upmnt
	if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
		echo "Error Failed to mount p1" ; exit 1
	fi

	#get current value
	ud_datcnv.elf -d -i /tmp_updater/upmnt/$_file -o /tmp_updater/upcurval -a
	if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
		echo "Could not get current value"
		umount /tmp_updater/upmnt
		exit 1
	fi

	local _current
	_current=`cat /tmp_updater/upcurval`
	rm -f /tmp_updater/upcurval

	#write new value into tempfile
	echo "$_newval" > /tmp_updater/upnewval
	ud_datcnv.elf -e -i /tmp_updater/upnewval -o /tmp_updater/upmnt/$_file -a
	if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
		echo "Could not write new value" ; unmount /tmp_updater/upmnt ; exit 1 ;
	fi

	umount /tmp_updater/upmnt

	rm -rf /tmp_updater/upnewval /tmp_updater/upmnt

	if [ ! -e /root/IAMUPDATER ] ; then
		umount /tmp_updater
	fi

	#message
	echo "Modify $1 $_current -> $_newval"

}

### console on/off
# $1 : on/off
func_cons()
{
	local _flag=$1

	if [ ! -e /root/IAMUPDATER ] ; then
		mount -t tmpfs -o size=1024 tmpfs /tmp_updater
	fi

	mkdir -p /tmp_updater/upmnt
	mount -t vfat /dev/nflasha1 -o posix_attr,noatime,nodiratime,shortname=mixed /tmp_updater/upmnt
	if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
		echo "Error Failed to mount p1" ; exit 1
	fi

	if [ $_flag = "off" ] ; then
		sed -e 's/console=ttyAMA0,460800n8 amba2.console=1/console=ttynull/g' /tmp_updater/upmnt/boot/kemco.txt > /tmp_updater/upmnt/boot/kemco_new.txt
	else
		sed -e 's/console=ttynull/console=ttyAMA0,460800n8 amba2.console=1/g' /tmp_updater/upmnt/boot/kemco.txt > /tmp_updater/upmnt/boot/kemco_new.txt
	fi
	mv /tmp_updater/upmnt/boot/kemco_new.txt /tmp_updater/upmnt/boot/kemco.txt

	umount /tmp_updater/upmnt

	rm -rf /tmp_updater/upnewval /tmp_updater/upmnt

	if [ ! -e /root/IAMUPDATER ] ; then
		umount /tmp_updater
	fi

	#message
	echo "console $_flag"

}

##########################################
## main 
##########################################


if [ $# -eq 0 ] ; then

# if not exist ,  create directory
if [ ! -d "$UPDIR" ];then
	mkdir $UPDIR
fi

# create file
if [ -f "$UPMODE" ];then
	rm -f $UPDIR/mode*
else
	touch $UPMODE $UPMODE1
fi
# write nand 
sync

# file check and message
if [ -f "$UPMODE" ];then
	echo "next boot...   Updater mode"
	mode_num=4
else
	echo "next boot...   Normal mode"
	mode_num=0
fi

else
#########################################
## user, service, modmod, modver, modreg

case $1 in
#	"keep" )
#		func_keepbackup
#		;;
	"user" )
		func_usermode
		mode_num=2
		;;
	"serv" )
		func_servicemode
		mode_num=3
		;;
	"modmod" )
		func_modmod $2
		;;
	"modver" )
		func_modver $2
		;;
	"modreg" )
		func_modreg $2
		;;
	"ms" )
		func_mscrypt
		mode_num=5
		;;
	"ver" )
		func_verskip
		mode_num=6
		;;
	"file" )
		func_filecrypt
		mode_num=7
		;;
	*)
		;;
esac

fi

if [ $((mode_num)) -ne 0 ]; then
	if [ -e /setting/updater/debug ] ; then
		func_cons on
	elif [ -e /setting/updater/consoff ] ; then
		func_cons off
	fi
fi

test -e /root/IAMUPDATER
if [ $? = 0 ]; then
	exit 0
fi

ud_send_lsi.elf $mode_num
